title: Timeline milestone update and visitor comment submission UI

requirements.summary: Update the centralized timeline dataset to include the user-provided 2003–2020 milestones and add clearly editable positive placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: `anniversaryContent.timeline` contains milestones representing all 7 user-provided entries (years and dates preserved as written by the user).
The timeline still renders correctly in `TimelineSection` with no layout break across mobile/desktop.
At least 2 additional timeline items are added as positive, generic placeholders (e.g., clearly labeled for later editing) and are editable in the same `anniversaryContent.timeline` array.

file_operations.description: Replace/extend `anniversaryContent.timeline` to include all 7 user-provided milestones (preserving years/dates exactly as written: 2003 06 feb, 2004 19 march, 2009, 2010, 2016 car, 2016 shifted to campus, 2020 covid pandemic) and add at least 2 additional positive placeholder milestones clearly labeled as editable (e.g., 'Placeholder — edit this'). Ensure entries remain compatible with `TimelineSection` expectations (year/title/description strings).

requirements.summary: Add a visitor comment submission form and display persisted comments in the Comments section using React Query and the existing backend actor hook.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend: `backend/main.mo` implements comment storage and exposes methods to (1) list comments and (2) add a comment (with basic validation such as non-empty fields and reasonable max lengths).
Backend data persists across page refreshes/upgrades using stable storage (add `backend/migration.mo` only if required by an existing state upgrade).
Frontend: `CommentsSection` includes a visible form with inputs for visitor name and comment plus a submit button.
Frontend: On submit, the UI calls the backend to store the comment, then refreshes the displayed list without a full page reload (React Query).
Frontend: The Comments section displays a list that includes newly submitted comments; submission shows user feedback for loading and error states.
No photo or music-related UI/logic is reintroduced while implementing this feature.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook layer for comments/posts: fetch the list via the backend actor (`getPosts`) and provide an add mutation via (`addPost`) that invalidates/refetches the posts query on success. Keep validation/user messaging in the UI layer (this hook should focus on data fetching/mutation and cache refresh).

Implement a visitor comment submission UI (name + comment + submit) and replace/augment the displayed list to render backend-provided posts. Use React Query (via the new `usePosts` hook) to load posts and to submit a new post without full page reload; show loading and error states for both list fetch and submission. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button/Input/Textarea/Card as available) to build the form and list styling—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure all user-facing text for the new form (labels, placeholders, button text, and error messages) is in English.
